The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ec0e1bb240b41be6), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. statement: For sufficiently small δ at fixed L, let a finite-volume real background have finitely many possible anchors, satisfy (3.9), and have finite principal norms. Every admissible source jet with finitely many labels then has a transformed centered jet H′(ζ) and a saved scalar jet s′(ζ) such that Z eH(ζ) dµ0 = es′(ζ) Z eH′(ζ) dµ0. (3.16) The equality is coefficientwise in the square-free variables and holds for every disorder realization and every choice of decision seeds. Consequently the normalized source partition function is R eH(ζ) dµ0 R eH(0) dµ0 = es′(ζ)−s′(0) R eH′(ζ) dµ0 R eH′(0) dµ0 . (3.17) All pure bad output is principal, and the linearization at zero is (3.14).
